## 3. Stability across regions and eras

Each cell: correlation (centred profiles) between the class fitted on that subset and on all other records. Ceiling = same-size random subset of the other records (sampling noise only). Floor = the subset with each feature shuffled independently (co-occurrence destroyed); max of 3 shuffles, per class, in brackets. A class whose r does not clear its own floor is not evidence of co-occurring features: one-feature classes (e.g. "cigar 100%") are re-created from shuffled data.

## 8. Drift around dated events

Share after vs before (same-length windows); odds ratio, Wald 95% CI. Placebo = fraction of other break dates with a smaller |log OR|. Trend-adjusted = segmented regression level change at the date net of the pre-trend (quasi-binomial), with its own placebo; "holds" means it beats 90% of placebo dates in the same direction. Data: NUFORC reports posted within a year (n = 93397), Hatch dated (n = 16982), GEIPAN contemporaneous (n = 3307).

| test | kind | break | window | before → after | OR (95% CI) | placebo pct | trend-adjusted OR (95% CI) | trend-adjusted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CONTROL Starlink 2019-05: NUFORC "starlink|line/string/train of lights" | control-physical | 2019-05 | ±18 months | 0.75% → 15.65% | 24.12 (16.62–35.02) | 1.00 | 13.06 (0.05–3397.59) | too noisy to adjust |
| CONTROL Starlink 2019-05: same, WITHOUT the word "starlink" | control-physical | 2019-05 | ±18 months | 0.62% → 1.27% | 2.03 (1.30–3.17) | 0.90 | 4.77 (0.91–25.09) | too noisy to adjust |
